name: self-evolving-agent
tagline: A 6-stage multi-agent pipeline with semantic embeddings, real-time streaming monitor, and fleet analysis. Analyzes your AI's logs, measures what actually improved, and proposes evidence-based AGENTS.md changes. You approve everything.
description: v5.0 adds three new pillars on top of the v4.3 pipeline: (1) Semantic Embeddings — uses Ollama nomic-embed-text locally to perform true semantic similarity matching, reducing false positives from ~15% to ~8%. (2) Streaming Monitor — real-time log watching with threshold-based instant alerts (<30s latency), replacing weekly-only detection. (3) Fleet Analysis — cross-instance pattern comparison across multiple agent instances (opus/sonnet/haiku). All three pillars degrade gracefully: Ollama offline → v4 heuristic fallback, no sessions → skip with report. AGENTS.md is never modified without explicit human approval. v4 orchestrator still works unchanged.
author: ramsbaby
honestLimitations: Semantic embeddings require Ollama (auto-fallback to v4 heuristics if offline)
False positives reduced from ~15% to estimated ~8% with embeddings — still imperfect
Streaming monitor adds <30s real-time detection but requires persistent process
Fleet analysis requires multiple agent instances in ~/.openclaw/agents/
Trend analysis needs 4+ weeks of history for meaningful results
Cold start — first 2-4 weeks have little trend data
Effect measurement is frequency-based correlation, not causation
safetyFeatures: AGENTS.md never modified without explicit user approval
All proposals cite measured evidence (real counts from real logs)
Embedding cache stores vectors only — no raw message text
Rejection reasons logged and respected in future cycles
Diff format only — no vague suggestions
Local-first: all stages run on your machine; only synthesis draft optionally hits the API
~500 lines of readable shell scripts — audit before running
Effect measurement — tracks whether previous proposals actually helped
Graceful degradation — Ollama offline = heuristic fallback, not crash

changelog.notes: Three new pillars: Semantic Embeddings (Ollama nomic-embed-text, ~8% FP), Streaming Monitor (real-time <30s alerts, --poll mode for CI), Fleet Analysis (cross-instance pattern comparison). New: scripts/v5/ directory, trend-analyzer.sh, embedding cache. New CLI: sea monitor/alerts/trends/patterns/fleet. Graceful fallback: Ollama offline → v4 heuristics. v4 orchestrator unchanged.

Interactive approval (sea watch), multi-format report export (html/json/pdf), GitHub Issues integration. New: interactive-approve.sh, export-report.sh, github-issue.sh. CLI v1.1.0: watch/export/github commands.
Ollama/local LLM support. llm-call.sh: anthropic/openai/ollama/none unified interface. Zero-cost mode: provider: ollama → $0.00/week.
Multi-platform delivery (Slack/Telegram/Webhook), ko/en complaint pattern separation, auto language detection.

4-stage multi-agent pipeline (collect → analyze → benchmark → synthesize). Structured heuristic analysis with role filtering, context windows, per-session deduplication. Closed feedback loop: effect measurement benchmarks previous proposals. False positive rate reduced from ~40% to estimated ~15%. Performance targets: <3 min, <$0.05/run.
exec retry loop detection, per-file error signature grouping fix, build_report heredoc backtick interpolation fix, config.yaml false-positive patterns cleanup.
config.yaml support, self-improving-agent .learnings/ integration, config-loader.sh added.
Initial release. Chat analysis, cron error detection, rule violation tracking, diff-format proposals, rejection learning.
